title: Uniformly bounded-below coefficient complex presentation with canonical tensor maps
statement: Fix a scheme $X$ in universe $u$, a prime $\ell$, and finite intermediate fields $E,F\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Use the internal module categories of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category] and the fixed scalar extension, restriction, adjunction, and tensor comparison data of [def-weil-pbc-finite-derived-tensor-comparison]; in particular $\Omega_X$ uses finite-subfield-valued continuous functions, not the full continuous-function sheaf. Let $L\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{F_X})$ be bounded below in the standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Let $I$ be a small filtered category in universe $u+1$, let $H:I\to\operatorname{FiniteIntermediateField}(\ell)$ be final, and suppose $E,F\subset H(i)$ for every $i$. There exist a diagram $N:I\to\operatorname{Ch}(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_X})$, a colimit cocone $c$, an integer $a$ with $N_i^r=0$ for every $i$ and $r<a$, and isomorphisms $e_\Omega:Q(c.\mathrm{pt})\cong U_{\Omega,E}T_{F,\Omega}L$ and $e_i:Q(N_i)\cong U_{H(i),E}T_{F,H(i)}L$ simultaneously for all $i$. For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_X})$ and $g:K\to Q(N_i)$, transpose $g$ followed by $e_i$ under the fixed $E/H(i)$ adjunction, extend the resulting morphism to $\Omega$, conjugate by the fixed tensor comparisons on its source and target, and transpose under the fixed $E/\Omega$ adjunction. The resulting morphism equals $g$ followed by $Q(c.\iota_i)$ and $e_\Omega$. Here $Q$ is localization of complexes at quasi-isomorphisms. There is no constructibility or bounded-above assumption, and no Hom-descent assertion.

proof.text: Represent the bounded-below derived F-object L by a cochain complex C strictly zero below an integer a, using DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE. For each index i, take termwise extension F -> H(i) followed by restriction H(i) -> E. The inclusion H(i) -> H(j), tensor the identity of C, is E-linear and commutes with differentials. The coefficient maps compose, so these maps define a genuine functor N. Use the same construction with Omega as the cocone vertex.

proof.text: The source theorem isColimitPadicAlgClRingObjCocone gives the coefficient colimit in abelian pro-etale sheaves. Finality of H preserves its universal property. Tensor in either variable preserves colimits; expressing balanced tensor as a coequalizer commutes that colimit with the two action maps. The forgetful functor from internal E-module objects creates these colimits. Therefore the tensor cocone is a colimit degreewise, hence in complexes. Every term below a vanishes because both coefficient functors are additive.

proof.text: Exactness identifies the total derived tensor functors with termwise tensor, and exact restriction is already termwise on the derived category. Together with C representing L this supplies the vertex and stage isomorphisms. The tensor/restriction units and multiplication maps commute with coefficient inclusions: on complexes both sides send m to 1 tensor m and then use the same inclusion. Localize this equality of natural transformations. The defining factorization equations of the exact-derived comparison and derived natural-isomorphism constructors identify its comparisons with the fixed comparison of the helper node, proving the stated equality for every K and g. This is a comparison of the actual cocone maps, not an abstract bijection of Hom sets.

theorem exists_condensed_coefficient_complex_presentation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E F : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ F)))
    (hL : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus L)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (H : I ⥤ FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) [H.Final]
    (he : ∀ i, E ≤ H.obj i) (hf : ∀ i, F ≤ H.obj i) :
    ∃ N : I ⥤ CochainComplex
        (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E)) ℤ,
      ∃ c : Cocone N, Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
      (∃ a : ℤ, ∀ (i : I) (r : ℤ), r < a → IsZero ((N.obj i).X r)) ∧
      ∃ eΩ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt ≅
          (finiteCoefficientDerivedFromAlgCl X ℓ E).obj
            ((finiteCoefficientDerivedToAlgCl X ℓ F).obj L),
        ∃ ei : ∀ i : I, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N.obj i) ≅
            (finiteCoefficientDerivedRestriction X ℓ (he i)).obj
              ((finiteCoefficientDerivedExtension X ℓ (hf i)).obj L),
          ∀ (i : I) (K : DerivedCategory
              (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E)))
            (g : K ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N.obj i)),
            finiteCoefficientDerivedAlgClHomEquiv X ℓ E K _
              ((finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ (he i)).inv.app K ≫
                (finiteCoefficientDerivedToAlgCl X ℓ (H.obj i)).map
                    ((finiteCoefficientDerivedHomEquiv X ℓ (he i) K _).symm
                        (g ≫ (ei i).hom)) ≫
                  (finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ (hf i)).hom.app L) =
              g ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (c.ι.app i) ≫ eΩ.hom
